answer: Proposed gate: each ID/day buys 1 kWh consumed by a river beacon. An ID-bound receipt thread links payment to unique meter increments. Validators check utility signatures, payment, quantity and nonreuse; failure denies listing. Ten IDs need 10 kWh/day: pooling and parallel agents cannot reuse allocations. Meters are reusable capital; electricity purchases recur; no stake. Honest utility metering is assumed; collusion can fake receipts and cheap surplus power weakens the expense floor. This meters funded service, not unique owners.
